description: When a role container initialises or updates the holon-coherence submodule inside a mounted worktree, its gitfile and core.worktree retain container-relative paths that break host-side git checkout during Stage 4 and Stage 5.
goal: Add a shared helper apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/submodule_gitfile.py (new) and update apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/executor/repair.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/stages/review.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/stages/calibrate.py so role containers write host-valid relative submodule gitdir paths (or stop container-path drift) and Stage 4/Stage 5 host checkout hooks detect and repair any unresolvable submodule gitfile before reattaching or checking out branches (in review.py before reattach_branch checks whether the worktree is already on the execution branch, and in calibrate.py before checkout, failing clearly with the offending path if repair fails). Resolve module gitdirs cleanly via git rev-parse --git-path. Keep all modules within their 350-line budgets and holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched. Add hermetic tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_executor_repair.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_calibrate.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_review_keeps_branch.py verifying repair before Stage 4/Stage 5 checkouts (including when already on the execution branch) under uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Ensuring container git setup and Stage 4/5 pre-checkout guards repair or reject broken submodule gitfiles prevents mid-checkout failures during review and calibration.
acceptance_criteria: Where a role container initialises or updates the holon-coherence submodule in the mounted worktree via entrypoint/executor/repair.py and submodule_gitfile.py, either stop it (role containers do not need the submodule) or make it write host-valid, relative paths (`git submodule absorbgitdirs` / relative `gitdir:`).

Host-side stages (4 and 5, in flow/stages/review.py before reattach_branch and flow/stages/calibrate.py) detect an unresolvable submodule gitfile before any checkout and repair it, or fail with a clear message naming the file, instead of failing mid-checkout.

Tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_executor_repair.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_calibrate.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_review_keeps_branch.py prove a worktree whose submodule gitfile points at a container path is repaired or rejected before Stage 4/Stage 5 checks out (keeping all modules within 350 lines and holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched); `uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress"`, `uv run task lint`, and `uv run task lint-docs` pass, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
